1: // Simple Space Debris Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11: 
12:   // Resize canvas to its displayed size (optional if already set in HTML/CSS)
13:   const resize = () => {
14:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
15:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
16:   };
17:   resize();
18:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
19: 
20:   // Ship definition (simple triangle)
21:   const ship = {
22:     x: canvas.width / 2,
23:     y: canvas.height - 30,
24:     size: 20, // half‑width of base
25:     speed: 300, // pixels per second
26:   };
27: 
28:   // Input state
29:   const keys = { left: false, right: false, fire: false };
30:   document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
31:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = true;
32:     else if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = true;
33:     else if (e.code === 'Space') keys.fire = true;
34:   });
35:   document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
36:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = false;
37:     else if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = false;
38:     else if (e.code === 'Space') keys.fire = false;
39:   });
40: 
41:   // Debris array
42:   const debris = [];
43:   let spawnAccumulator = 0;
44:   const BASE_SPAWN_RATE = 1.0; // seconds
45:   const MIN_SPAWN_RATE = 0.2;
46:   let laserCooldown = 0; // seconds remaining
47: 
48:   let startTime = null;
49:   let elapsed = 0; // seconds survived
50: 
51:   // Helper: distance between two points
52:   const dist = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => Math.hypot(x1 - x2, y1 - y2);
53: 
54:   const spawnDebris = () => {
55:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 10;
56:     const x = radius + Math.random() * (canvas.width - 2 * radius);
57:     const speedY = 100 + Math.random() * 100 + elapsed * 5; // increase speed over time
58:     debris.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speedY });
59:   };
60: 
61:   const update = (dt) => {
62:     // Move ship
63:     if (keys.left) ship.x -= ship.speed * dt;
64:     if (keys.right) ship.x += ship.speed * dt;
65:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.size, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.size, ship.x));
66: 
67:     // Laser fire
68:     if (keys.fire && laserCooldown <= 0) {
69:       // Find first debris within 30px of ship centre
70:       const targetIndex = debris.findIndex(d => dist(d.x, d.y, ship.x, ship.y) < d.radius + 30);
71:       if (targetIndex !== -1) debris.splice(targetIndex, 1);
72:       laserCooldown = 2.0; // seconds
73:     }
74:     if (laserCooldown > 0) laserCooldown -= dt;
75: 
76:     // Spawn debris
77:     spawnAccumulator += dt;
78:     const spawnRate = Math.max(MIN_SPAWN_RATE, BASE_SPAWN_RATE - elapsed * 0.01);
79:     while (spawnAccumulator >= spawnRate) {
80:       spawnDebris();
81:       spawnAccumulator -= spawnRate;
82:     }
83: 
84:     // Update debris positions and check collisions
85:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
86:       const d = debris[i];
87:       d.y += d.speedY * dt;
88:       // Remove off‑screen
89:       if (d.y - d.radius > canvas.height) {
90:         debris.splice(i, 1);
91:         continue;
92:       }
93:       // Collision with ship (approximate ship as circle)
94:       if (dist(d.x, d.y, ship.x, ship.y) < d.radius + ship.size / 2) {
95:         // Game over – stop animation loop by not requesting next frame
96:         gameOver();
97:         return;
98:       }
99:     }
100:   };
101: 
102:   const draw = () => {
103:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
104: 
105:     // Draw ship (triangle pointing up)
106:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
107:     ctx.beginPath();
108:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.size);
109:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
110:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
111:     ctx.closePath();
112:     ctx.fill();
113: 
114:     // Draw debris
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a33';
116:     debris.forEach(d => {
117:       ctx.beginPath();
118:       ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
119:       ctx.fill();
120:     });
121: 
122:     // Draw score
123:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
124:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
125:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${elapsed.toFixed(1)}s`, 10, 20);
126: 
127:     // Draw laser cooldown indicator
128:     if (laserCooldown > 0) {
129:       ctx.fillText(`Laser: ${laserCooldown.toFixed(1)}s`, 10, 40);
130:     }
131:   };
132: 
133:   let animationId = null;
134:   const gameOver = () => {
135:     cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
136:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
137:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
138:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
139:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
140:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
141:     ctx.fillText(`Game Over! Survived ${elapsed.toFixed(1)} seconds`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
142:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
143:   };
144: 
145:   const loop = (timestamp) => {
146:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
147:     const dt = (timestamp - (animationId ? lastTimestamp : timestamp)) / 1000;
148:     elapsed = (timestamp - startTime) / 1000;
149:     update(dt);
150:     draw();
151:     lastTimestamp = timestamp;
152:     animationId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
153:   };
154:   let lastTimestamp = performance.now();
155:   animationId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
156: })();

(End of file - total 156 lines)
</content>
